Common Workplace Questions

Explore common workplace tasks and activities to discover relevant digital competences, practical guidance and learning resources.

Start with what you're trying to achieve and we'll help connect you with the most relevant capability areas.

What are you trying to do?

Try: write a prompt, Teams or email, improve data quality, accessibility, AI summary, stakeholder engagement.

Popular Questions

Get started with questions people often ask.

AI and Digital Tools

How do I write an effective prompt?

Be clear about the task, audience, context and format you need. Avoid entering sensitive information, and check the result before using it.

AI and Digital Tools

Can AI help summarise documents?

AI may help identify key points, but use only approved tools and check the summary against the original document before relying on it.

AI and Digital Tools

How do I verify AI-generated content?

Check AI-generated information against trusted sources, organisational guidance and subject matter expertise before relying on or sharing it.

Information and Data

How do I find reliable information?

Search trusted sources, check who created the information and when, and compare important claims with other authoritative evidence.

Communication and Collaboration

When should I use Teams instead of email?

Choose the channel that fits the task, audience and information. Use shared workspaces for ongoing collaboration and follow agency guidance for records and sensitive content.

Creating Content

How do I create accessible content?

Use clear language, meaningful headings, descriptive links, text alternatives for images and accessible document formats. Check content with relevant accessibility tools.

Improving Ways of Working

How can I improve a business process?

Understand the current process and user needs, identify delays or repeated work, and test a small improvement with the people who use it.

Security and Privacy

What should I do if I suspect a phishing attempt?

Do not click links or open unexpected attachments. Report the message using your agency's process and contact your service desk if you interacted with it.
